description:
The City of Oakwood needs its 2024 Consumer Confidence Report (CCR) formatted for accessibility (Section 508 compliance). 

Your task is to create the report in Apache OpenOffice Writer using the content provided in '/home/ga/Documents/water_data.json' and the chart image at '/home/ga/Documents/ph_levels_chart.png'.

Requirements:
1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer (if not already open).
2. copy the text content from the JSON file into the document.
3. Apply 'Heading 1' style to the main title and 'Heading 2' style to section titles (do NOT just use bold).
4. Insert the 'ph_levels_chart.png' image into the 'Test Results' section.
5. CRITICAL: Set the image Alternative Text (Description) to: "Annual pH levels showing stability between 7.2 and 7.4".
6. Create the Contaminant Data table found in the JSON file.
7. CRITICAL: Configure the first row of the table as a 'Header Row' (Table > Properties > Text Flow > Repeat heading).
8. Set the Document Title property (File > Properties > Description > Title) to "2024 Water Quality Report".
9. Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/Oakwood_CCR_2024.odt'.

metadata.expected_alt_text: Annual pH levels showing stability between 7.2 and 7.4
